_about: MIS showcase step 1 (REQ-MIS-SHOWCASE-2026-11-16): the data tools/sim-load.cjs --months reads. Every figure is AUD and DEMO. daily_ex_gst = the walk-in cash takings of EVERY day of that month, before 10% GST (daily x days x 1.1 = the month's walk-in total). Shape: a gentle rise (about 8% a year) times a season (Jul and Feb slow, Dec best). Best month Dec 2025, slowest Feb 2025. Hand-written totals for three months: tools/seed/mis-history-expected.json.
